title: Regarding the Slayer

sources.title: Piercing Growl
markers: full damage on a saving throw

summary: Read to gain Slayer Knowledge and unlock Piercing Growl for an eligible Dark Urge Slayer.

fields.Slayer Knowledge: Reading grants a permanent passive to all characters. Gain advantage on saves against a Slayer’s Relentless Lunge and Piercing Growl, including the full ability saves rather than only their fear effects.
fields.Piercing Growl: Dark Urge in Slayer form. Action, 30 ft cone, 3d8 + 4 Piercing. Constitution save vs Slayer spell save DC avoids Bleeding and Fearful for 2 turns. The source reports full damage on a successful save despite the half-damage tooltip. Save DC uses the last new class’s spellcasting ability, using Slayer scores.
fields.Acquisition: Rescue Volo by the Lower City docks in Act Three and speak with him at camp.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
